text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Summer. 
For an Umamusume, it is the season of 
competition."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"How much did you run this summer? How 
well did you study your rivals? 
Pouring in all your willpower and 
stamina—honing yourself to perfection 
without a shred of compromise."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"—See it through to the end. For victory 
lies only beyond that! 
And yet... even so—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Display event title logo.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Summer. 
For an Umamusume, it's—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"A totally suuuper fun season! Oh em gee, 
it's finally here~~~! 
Like, there's literally zero reason not to 
get hyped, right?!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"So, I'm gonna invite Ai-chan and party 
all summer long~! 
Wooo~~hoo☆"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"One, two... three, four...! 
Five, six... seven, eight...!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, looks like she's kinda busy? 
Welp, guess I'll talk to her later~."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Phew, phew... alright! 
Let's do another lap of long-distance 
swimming...!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"So here, y=3/4... okay! Done with math 
prep! 
Next is... Japanese literature. ........."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"29... 30! ...Haa, haa... Ah, is it that 
late already? 
I have to get to the baths before they 
close!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: .........Isn't this getting ridiculous?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I haven't had a single opening to talk to 
her 
aaaall day loooong~~~~?!"

text_block_list.name: Eye & Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Haa, haa, haa... Aha. 
Yay! I beat Kiseki-chan again! Yay—!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Haa, haa... Guuuuugh! Man, 
there's still... this much of a gap... 
Dammit!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Well then—how about one more! 
I'm ready to keep going, what about you, 
Kiseki-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Haa~... I'm in, of course! 
As many times as it takes until I strike 
back at you!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, thank you! I was really hoping to 
run with lots of people 
during this training camp! Looking forward 
to the next one, Kiseki-cha—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Hold it right theeeeere!! Give it a rest 
alreadyyyy!!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I've been watching quietly, but Ai-chan! 
You're working way, way, waaaay too hard! 
You're making me worry!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I get that you wanna push yourself at 
summer camp, but still! 
Nothing but training is super bad for you! 
Your body's gonna break!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"So like... you know? 
Come play with meee♡"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Um, Pandora-san. I appreciate the 
thought, but... 
I'm sorry. I can't do that."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Waaaaaaaahhhhh! 
The SS Crybaby has officially set 
sail~~~?! Why you gotta be like that, 
Ai-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"No seriously, you're being way too 
diligent! Isn't it fine? 
It's summer! You can take it a little 
easier, can't you~...?!"

text_block_list.name: Bright & Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Hwaa~... 
Fuwaaa~..."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Right, just like that~... Wait, huh? 
Like, there are some super 
chill upperclassmen right here. Whoa. 
Whatcha guys up to~?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh my, Pandora-sama~. Good day to you~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"What do you mean, can't you tell by 
looking? 
We're taking our lunch break. Hwaa~."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, is that so...? Even though it's 
already 3 PM? 
Aha, you're totally just slacking off, 
aren't you~?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...No, wait, actually that makes sense. 
Right? It is summer, after all! 
Taking a break is super important too, 
y'know!!?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, hey, seniors~ There's someone I 
really want to teach 
about stuff like that. Would you mind 
lending a hand?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, pretty please? Kind seniors 
wouldn't turn down 
a request from their cute junior, 
right...? *puppy dog eyes*...☆"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Huh... A showdown...? Y-Yes, absolutely! 
Nothing would make me happier!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, looks like you're up for it! Well 
then, 
will both of you come along with me?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"A match against Sky-senpai...! It must be 
a mock race, right? 
Ohhh man! I'm totally fired up!!"

text_block_list.name: Fishing Tournament Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Late registration, right! All set, you're 
registered! 
The tournament starts the day after 
tomorrow at 10:00 AM! Look forward to it!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? Tournament? But didn't we agree 
to do a mock race together... 
Huh? Wasn't that what we talked about...?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, nope? Did you get the wrong idea? 
What we're doing is—"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "A fishing tournament~☆ Yay!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Eeeeeeek!? A-A fishing tournament—!!?"
